headline: President Bush created a federal coordinator to oversee national government help for rebuilding the Gulf Coast after the 2005 hurricanes.
what_it_does: This executive order set up a new position, the Coordinator of Federal Support for the Recovery and Rebuilding of the Gulf Coast Region. Based on the title, the coordinator's job was to organize how federal agencies supported recovery and rebuilding in the Gulf Coast. No summary was provided, so the exact powers and duties are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Residents of Gulf Coast states hit by the 2005 hurricanes
who_it_affects.how: Federal help for their region's recovery was to be organized through a single coordinator.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies involved in disaster recovery
who_it_affects.how: Their rebuilding support for the Gulf Coast was to be coordinated by the new office.
